JPEG baseline encoder (pure Nim). Matches jpgdec.nim decoder. Standard Annex K Huffman tables + IJG quantization scaling. Supports Rgb8 (4:4:4 / 4:2:0) and Luma8.

Imports

../color, ../error, ../buffer, ../dynamic, ../math, ../simd

Types

JpegRequest = object
  img*: DynamicImage
  quality*: int
  subsample*: bool
  optimize*: bool
  hasCrop*: bool
  cropRect*: Rect
  reqErr*: Option[ImageError]
Fluent JPEG compression request: img.compress(50).crop(...).encode().
